entries.title: From Tool State to Scientific Action: Auditing Decision Provenance in Biomedical Research Agents
entries.description: A scientific agent can give the same verdict while reading and citing different evidence. BioAgent-DF tests this separation using paired reference and candidate values saved at the same scientific computation site.

entries.title: An auditable agentic pipeline for variant-to-gene prioritisation, validated against orthogonal functional evidence
entries.description: Assigning GWAS variants to causal genes requires evidence from multiple resources. We present V2G, an agentic pipeline that records evidence retrieval and returns ranked genes alongside the retrieved evidence.
